details:
As everyone knows these days, moving around with the quick menu open will automatically close the quick menu. I'm asking if we can please have an option to turn that function off, mostly for the sake of folks with drifty controllers. It's painful to use the menu system when you've got drifty controllers, especially when it's the left controller doing the drifting (IE, the one we usually navigate with).
I'll admit, I'm one of the folks presently affected by this, (at least for now: I have an Index inbound someday soon...) and sometimes controllers can't be fixed or replaced (for example, the Rift S is discontinued), so having this as a kind of "accessibility option" would be nice. Not to mention, I'm not sure why the menu is designed to close upon player movement in the first place (let alone why it's attached to the hands instead of, say, the chest, which would make it easier to use with one hand while wrangling the drifty stick in the other)...
title: Toggle quick-menu closure on player movement
